## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL, with broad strength. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive; confirmation is mixed, with the risk ratios neutral (→ flat) and SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) while TLT is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear easing near term: VXX is in CORRECTION (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%), so the weekly decline contrasts with a still-positive monthly change. Credit stress and stocks versus bonds are neutral (→ flat); no ratio changes are provided.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Mixed: TLT is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%), while HYG is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.27%) and LQD is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -0.28%). Dollar and yield-curve ETF data are unavailable.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Broad gains: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), XLP is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%), and XLK is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%). Breadth supports broad participation, but the monthly Tech lag leaves style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US and emerging markets are both rebounding: SPY is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) and EEM is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%). India is ABOVE TREND via INDA (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +7.30%), while China is BELOW TREND via FXI (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Small caps show resilience: IWM is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%). Speculation remains weak: ARKK is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) and IBIT is BELOW TREND (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Industrial metals and precious metals are weak: CPER is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%), GLD is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%), and SLV is BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy is bouncing but remains below its monthly mark: XLE is in RECOVERY (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%). Oil is BELOW TREND via BNO (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -5.86%); natural gas is in RECOVERY via UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed strength in XLF, ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), and IWM, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%). SPY and XLK are in RECOVERY, while VXX is in CORRECTION; the short-term rebound contrasts with weaker monthly equity and volatility readings.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor broad sector exposure over a concentrated style call: XLF is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), while XLK remains in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%). Monitor bonds, with TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%), and keep speculative exposure selective given ARKK’s BELOW TREND status (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If broad participation persists, favor XLF, ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%).  
BEARISH: If the monthly Tech weakness resumes, monitor XLK, in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If the weekly bounce holds, monitor XLE, in RECOVERY (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%).  
BEARISH: If metals weakness persists, monitor SLV, BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Monitor VXX’s direction (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%; CORRECTION), the neutral HYG/LQD signal (→ flat), and the neutral SPY/TLT signal (→ flat).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength. Financials and defensives are showing relative strength, while broad sector participation leaves style leadership mixed. Watch whether the equity recovery broadens and whether monthly Tech weakness persists.
